inquiries.query:
select 
	j.job_id, 
    j.job_title_short as title, 
    c.name as company_name
from 
	job_postings_fact as j 
left join 
	company_dim as c 
    on 
    	j.company_id = c.company_id;
        
select 
	j.job_id, 
    j.job_title_short as title, 
    c.name as company_name
from 
	job_postings_fact as j 
right join 
	company_dim as c 
    on 
    	j.company_id = c.company_id;
        
select 
	j.job_id, 
    j.job_title_short as title, 
    s.skill_id, 
    sd.skills
from 
	job_postings_fact as j 
inner join 
	skills_job_dim as s 
    on 
    	j.job_id = s.job_id
inner join 
	skills_dim as sd
    on 
    	s.skill_id = sd.skill_id;
        
select 
	s.skills as skill_name, 
    count(sd.job_id) as no_of_job_posting, 
    avg(j.salary_year_avg) as avg_salary_for_skill
from skills_dim as s
left join
	skills_job_dim as sd 
    on 
    	s.skill_id = sd.skill_id
left join job_postings_fact as j 
	on 
    	sd.job_id = j.job_id
group by 
	s.skills
order by 
	avg_salary_for_skill desc;
inquiries.name: join
